next.reason: 1985: 'identification-division [ environment-division ] [ data-division ] [ procedure-division ] [ end-program-header ]'; 2023: '[ IDENTIFICATION DIVISION. ] PROGRAM-ID. program-name-1 ... [ END PROGRAM program-name-1. ]'. Same division order with optional end marker, but 2023 makes the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION header optional, so a program opening with PROGRAM-ID alone is now accepted.
